notes.title: Sequel of Surabaya Inferno: The State of War in Java
notes.content:
Dear everyone 

Since January 2022, there are plan to make the sequel of Surabaya Inferno called Djayakarta 1945. Since August 2023, after reupdate Surabaya Inferno, we has prepared to make the concept of game calls "The State of War in Java" .

The State of War in Java focus on revolution in several places around Java start from Jakarta, Semarang, Bandung, Bekasi, Ambarawa, and Sukabumi.

Djayakarta 1945 is name of first episode of The State of War in Java which focus on revolution in Jakarta which quite different from revolution in Surabaya (Surabaya Inferno)

In late October 2023, we have developed the prototype of The State of War in Java and last week, we have make the prototype build. Now we have released the prototype in Itch.io 
For screenshots, you can see in here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/a0627722f8efb33a58cf4b562b36e1af3a0c4144.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/cf95b737c90f9ef479ac8ddb5adf179fa808f484.jpg[/img]

Link to visit and download The State of War in Java

Thank you for your attention

notes.title: Surabaya Inferno 1 Year Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone...

20 September 2021 marked as one year Sengkala Dev has released Surabaya Inferno, our first game in Steam.

As you probably know, currently Sengkala Dev developing Perang Laut Maritime Warfare. Here the link https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722410/Perang_Laut__Maritime_Warfare/.

For Surabaya Inferno, we have plan to make big update after Perang Laut Maritime Warfare since there are many things we want add.

The project for new version Surabaya Inferno is Radio of Resistance(RoR)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/0d7afa30b15101fc010ec36ac2698a78787e2e57.png[/img]

So what is Radio of Resistance's project?

Radio of Resistance is project where radio broadcasting play very critical in encourage Indonesian especially Surabayan. So in this game player will use radio to broadcasting news and encourage people.

This is still in plan and we will tell more information about this later. Oh, in this project lot of things will get fix and upgrade the game system.  Oh this is part of big upgrade for the game and not DLC.

Thank you

notes.title: The Flare Path: A2Z
notes.content:
A is for Alphabetised wargame and sim news.

Welcome to the cosy corner of RPS where the vehicular is valued, the historical is hallowed, and the paragraphs are shorter than 7.5 cm Kampfwagenkanone 37 L/24 barrels. While this flavour of Flare Path usually relies on the English alphabet for structure, in emergencies – in weeks when Life does its best to unscrew my monocle and turn my upper lip to jelly – I’m perfectly willing to use the dinky letter palette of the Rotokas people of Bougainville. (more…)

notes.title: Surabaya Inferno First update
notes.content:
After 1 week our game got released, this is good time to update our game.
There are many things that we fix and update 
[b]List fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] In User Interface, there are no texts of units name and replaced with number of units.
[*]now player can send units with 3 option button (we converting this texts to buttons). So you can send either with enter A,B, or C or just press in option.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/77e6cb7d0fb8a39ff63cad75da4af5c134271e2a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38577247/0a5a07b750b2f827b3a56cb7ae1b43405a8a2390.png[/img][/url]
[*] There are soundeffects when players send units 
[*] Now bofors sprite can change depend on there position of mouse
[*] Newest manual guide attached in game folder
[/list]

Soon there are another update...

notes.title: Released The Surabaya Inferno Manual Guide 1.0
notes.content:
This is manual guide from Sengkala Dev about basic gameplay of Surabaya Inferno. In introduction of Consolidation arc, we have expalin it but in this manual guide, lot of information that maybe not apper in game or quite hard to understand for playing. 

The information covers basic of units ability, how to move units, fighting, firing with bofors, and dialog system in consolidation arc.There are chance to revision this manual guide.

This is link the manual guide: shorturl.at/cfmEJ  (If we update game again, we will include manual in game folder)
